def check_amicable_number(n: int) -> bool:
    """
    Check if the number is amicable.

    - O(sqrt(n)) time-complexity
    - O(n) space-complexity
    """
    d_n = sum(find_proper_divisors(n) - {n})
    if n == d_n:
        return False
    d_dn = sum(find_proper_divisors(d_n) - {d_n})
    if n == d_dn:
        return True
    return False
